warnings: resolved: “Directly assert that the vendor portal displays a countdown timer.” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

plan.title: SRC-VEN-002 — Vendor live RFQ before bidding

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with no bids.
Move to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while preserving the buyer session.
Open the live RFQ's pricing round and bid sheet.
Assert that the vendor can see the pricing sheet.
Type a price without submitting to verify that the vendor's price sheet is editable.
Assert that the typed price remains in the sheet.
Assert that the vendor can see the event terms.
Assert that the submission control is available before the vendor bids.
